articles.title: Some Voters Are Asking AI Chatbots for Help With Their Ballots
articles.summary: Some U.S. voters are using AI chatbots to research candidates, but experts warn the tools can be too agreeable and sometimes wrong.

articles.title: A Very Strong El Niño Could Shake Up Weather Around the World
articles.summary: Forecasters say this year's El Niño could be the strongest on record, shifting rain and temperatures around the world.

articles.title: U.S. Bombers Leave a British Air Base After a Security Scare
articles.summary: The U.S. Air Force has moved its bombers out of a British base after an investigation into a suspected attack plan.
